spans.s:
n. (-ध्यं)
Singleness of time or occurrence.
E.
एक, and ध्यमुञ् aff.

n. (-त्यं)
Consent, concurrence, sameness of doctrine or opinion.
E.
एक one, मत minded, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-फः-फी-फं)
Produced by or belonging to animals with single hoofs.
E.
एकशफ, and अण aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 A thief, a robber.
2 The possessor of one residence.
E.
एक one, अगार a house, affix ठक्.

n. (-ग्र्यं)
Intentness. of one object.
E.
एकाग्र, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
One who commits a single error in reading.
E.
एक, and अन्य other, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Ephemeral, quotidian, of one day, of the same day.
E.
एक, and अहन a day, ठञ् aff.
